# Notesly now speaks MCP

We're excited to announce our hosted MCP server! Any MCP client can now read and write your Notesly notes.

To connect, sign up for a Notesly Pro account, then point your client at https://mcp.notesly.app/sse and sign in with OAuth when prompted.

Thanks for being with us since 2021.
